description: Implementation of DropdownReadPlatformService providing options for period frequency, condition types, days in month, and days in year.

classes.name: DropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class providing dropdown options for various period and condition types.

methods.name: retrievePeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns list of options for period frequency types such as days, weeks, months, years, and whole term.

methods.name: retrieveConditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns list of condition type options like equal, not equal, greater than, less than.

methods.name: retrieveDaysInMonthTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns list of days-in-month type options such as actual days and 30 days.

methods.name: retrieveDaysInYearTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns list of days-in-year type options including actual days, 360, 364, and 365 days.
